summary: This is a Quarto slide that displays an image with the filename 'image.webp' using a special stretching effect, followed by some text. The `.r-stretch` class makes the image expand to fill available space on the slide.

explanations.5: The `{.r-stretch}` syntax at the end adds a CSS class that tells the slide engine to stretch the image to fill the available width and height of the slide container.
